notes.title: Patch 0.28.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you all so much for the feedback you’ve been giving us. It really helps make the game better.
We’re continuing to work on it, and today’s update brings several new side quests, enemy reinforcement waves, and many bug fixes and minor improvements.
The next update is just around the corner and will introduce a "Feats" system—mini-quests for each character that grant bonuses upon completion.

Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Added 3 new side quests.
[*] Added battles with enemy reinforcement waves.
[*] Treasure points on the map, which previously could grant items/spells/heroes, are now split into 3 distinct types.
[*] Contracts that were previously unfulfilled are now prioritized.
[*] Fixed a bug where attack/spell ranges were incorrectly displayed when a hero was in a corner of the map.
[*] Fixed a bug where harpoon kills left lingering VFX.
[*] Illusions no longer deal armor damage.
[*] Allied illusions are now marked in the UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Hunter’s "Fas" ability drained action points from summoned wolves.
[*] Fixed a bug where killing with a trap did not free the dead unit’s cell.
[*] When an enemy summons an illusion, unit portraits are now randomized to prevent identifying which is the illusion.
[*] Ghouls can no longer burrow into a cell already occupied by another burrowing ghoul.
[*] The Water Spirit’s catfish will now spit out a swallowed character when the boss phase changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release date announcement of Spear Song and updated demo is available now!
notes.content:
We are glad to tell you when Spear Song will be released. It is 28 of May 2024!

Also, we want you to try our updated demo and give us your feedback so we can fix all the bugs and add new updates to the game after hearing your feedback! List of changes since the last demo release 28.08.2023:

[olist]
[*] Added map exploring mechanic. Player optionally can take part in additional battles for greater rewards, participate in random events and encounters, collect loot and information plaques about the area.
[*] Added inventory and items, each character now has 3 slots: weapons, armor and trinket. This way you can improve the character's stats by adding items to the corresponding slots. Items can be obtained as a reward for battle, picked up as loot on the map, or bought in the store
[*] Many environment assets have been reworked and detailed. Several characters have received their own visual update
[*] All character attack animations have been sped up for better combat dynamics
[*] Some of the abilities of player characters and evil forces have been changed. Some spell effects have been reworked
[*] Mana regeneration mechanics during combat have been added. There is now a progressive scale that fills up as the turn passes. When it fills up by 3 or more divisions, using it restores a portion of the characters mana. More you charge, more mane you mana regain.
[*] Added story missions, enemies on which are not randomly generated, but pre-determined. Story missions are in story branches of the map, and you can't get out of them until you fulfill a story contract.
[*] Added plot, which is presented through dialog boxes between the narrator and the listener, as well as with other characters of this world. The player needs to lead a squad of people's avengers, who set out to fight for the freedom of the common people from the oppression of the main villain - Koschey the Immortal.
[*] The battle interface has been redesigned in many aspects. Now there is a display curve where the character can run to, displaying the range of attack, and much more.
[*] Placement of characters at the beginning of the battle is no longer strictly limited to a few fields, the player is free to choose from the first 3 lanes where he put his heroes.
[*] Glory points (blue crystals that function as meta points) can now be gained and lost not only in battles, but also at random encounters and events. Added the ability to dodge non-story battles at the expense of glory points.
[*] Added a new boss - One-Eyed Likho
[/olist]


We will be glad to hear your feedback, it will help us to make the game better! Also subscribe to our social networks and Discord server:

Our project is a turn-based tactics strategy with rich and catchy graphics, inspired by Slavic folklore.
One of the features of our game is roguelike elements in tactical turn-based gameplay. Levels, enemies, and rewards are randomly generated. The dead heroes cannot be returned. If you lose, you’ll need to start all over again with a new squad.
 While developing the combat system, we strive to give the player an opportunity to combine character’s abilities and positional play. Some of the abilities allow you to manipulate the enemy's position on the map, while others inflict devastating damage on its positions. Thus, some characters can complement and strengthen others.
Operate the heroes, choose the best tactics and play out the battle from a position to defeat the evil forces that have invaded the kingdom.

During the game, you will fight famous characters of Slavic fairytales, myths and folklore, ranging from ghouls who prowl the fields in search of prey, ending with the dreadful three-headed dragon, terrorizing the inhabitants of the surrounding villages. 
Many warriors went beyond the strong walls of the capital and just as many laid down their heads in the fight against evil. Now it's your turn to go on a crusade. Will you be able to drive the enemies from these lands and survive through difficult battles? We'll find out soon.
